objective: Enable ordinary ChatGPT conversation to dispatch generic versioned repository tasks and read artifacts without project-specific bridge code
acceptance_criteria: Repository task definitions specify tracked scripts and argv as data at an exact Git commit
One-time local workspace grants replace bridge code edits per project or script
The same runner works for two independent fixture projects with no domain-specific branches
Existing async claims, locks, pinned Git checks, reports and handoffs remain compatible
Declared text/JSON/ZIP report artifacts can be read through bounded typed MCP output
Natural-language ChatGPT instructions select tools automatically; no user-authored task JSON is required
